title: 国民党主席郑丽文访问大陆 陆委会呼吁：见了习近平要大胆提诉求｜新闻特写20260408
executive_summary: The video discusses Kuomintang (KMT) Chairperson Zheng Lihwen's visit to mainland China and the response from the Straits Exchange Foundation and the Mainland Affairs Council.

key_facts: KMT Chairperson Zheng Lihwen visited mainland China.
The Mainland Affairs Council urged Zheng to boldly express Taiwan's demands during her meeting with Xi Jinping.
forward_implications: The visit and the response from Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council may impact cross-strait relations and Taiwan's political landscape.
The meeting between Zheng and Xi Jinping could influence future interactions between Taiwan and mainland China.
